sources.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
sources.snippet: Gemini Robotics 2: Our most advanced vision-language-action model (VLA) that converts vision and language input into motor control, enabling a robot to take action. This model is capable of controlling full humanoids, from feet to fingertips, and other bi-arm robots. It also brings a new level of dexterous manipulation on both hands and grippers.
